common: ChatGPT remains final commander and integrator

for normal media research and script authoring, ChatGPT plus DeepSeek operate as the default compact judgmental pair rather than creating separate routine research, writer, rewriter and reviewer agents
parallelize only independent work when expected wall-clock savings exceed handoff and coordination overhead; join dependencies explicitly
single writer owns each mutable output
current media creative policy controls YMM4-or-equivalent visible behavior, VOICEVOX timing, character motion and captions
reusable registered assets are resolved cache-first before search, while rights and semantic fit remain mandatory
Zundamon and Metan reaction assets are downloaded once, preprocessed into a verified local reaction pack, and reused without per-video search or download
character motion must include expression, pose, lateral, scale, tilt, focus or reaction-state changes; vertical bounce alone is insufficient
mouth motion alone is not character acting; eyes, eyebrows, face state, pose and listener reaction should follow the semantic beat
normalize Zundamon and Metan by perceived visual size before speaker-focus scaling, then enlarge the active speaker naturally without causing caption, evidence or safe-zone collisions
VOICEVOX pronunciation text is separate from on-screen caption text; English brand and technical terms use official Latin spelling in captions by default

Zundamon and Metan production starts from a reusable YMM4-or-equivalent template, script-first dialogue fields, reusable pronunciation dictionary and cached audio/visual assets rather than rebuilding common setup per video
shortform 2-3 second cadence is a meaningful visual-state-change heuristic, not a forced new-image download or fixed-cut rule
SFX and camera effects are semantic accents; sound on every cut and constant zoom remain forbidden
jet cuts remove accidental dead air while preserving deliberate silence and natural phrasing
character size, position and recurring motion come from deterministic presets rather than per-video reinvention or motion downloads
mechanical render, timing, encoding, hashing, ffprobe and decode QA use deterministic tools instead of extra AI agents
video_creation: search is discovery, not a license
check the reusable asset registry and verified cache before new search or download
resolve the Zundamon/Metan reaction pack before character rendering and load its inventory once per render
build one structured canonical dialogue script from the ChatGPT plus DeepSeek research-and-script stage before timeline assembly and batch-import when the editing path supports it
use a reusable VOICEVOX pronunciation dictionary for recurring foreign and technical terms
use rights-verified real or official visuals by default
measure actual audio duration and align captions to audio boundaries
keep katakana pronunciation in voice_text while using official English spelling in caption_text for English proper nouns and technical terms
for shortform/news explainers prefer a truthful 1-3 second hook over a generic greeting unless context or safety requires otherwise
longform-only reliability material is loaded only for longform work
clipping_repurposing: source rights and platform monetization eligibility are separate gates
permission does not guarantee YouTube reused-content monetization eligibility
commercial rights to all material audio and visual elements must be resolved for monetized YouTube output
context integrity is blocking: do not reverse, materially distort or overstate source meaning
publishable third-party clips retain a transformation manifest describing source range, context and original value added
channel-level mass-template and reused-content risk is reviewed rather than judging each clip in isolation
ASR/alignment, candidate scoring, duplicate suppression, sentence boundaries, reframe, captions and machine QA form the clipping pipeline
known TTS timing may bypass unnecessary ASR
mechanical trim/cut/concat/reframe/caption burn/ffprobe work is deterministic rather than multi-agent debate
tiktok_shop_commerce: generic shopping intent first resolves the target platform; TikTok-specific rules are not universal commerce law
ingest and verify product-page evidence before final script claims
map every material product claim to evidence
reverify volatile price, coupon, stock, shipping, return and commission claims near publish time
commercial relationship disclosure and claim truth are separate blocking checks
Japan commercial disclosure must be clear in the overall presentation when applicable and must not be hidden only in a reply or remote description
TikTok Shop exact product/listing match, current affiliate qualification and current platform policy snapshot are required
TikTok Shop paid-media/ad-use authorization is separate from organic posting and is never mass-enabled automatically
if current TikTok Shop AIGC sources conflict, retrieve both at publish time and block AIGC publish handoff until resolved
persona and purchase motive are hypotheses to test, not invented facts
hooks and creative variants are experiments with measurable outcomes
